dedupe_keys.name: australian agricultural drought indicators aadi regional indicator evaluation data

description: This dataset holds the regional panel used to evaluate the Australian Agricultural Drought Indicators, which track agricultural and economic drought. The Mendeley Data page says it draws on AADI historical data, the ABARES Australian Agricultural and Grazing Industries Survey (AAGIS) and ABS Data by Region, in two CSV files, one by AAGIS region and one by local government area, with a readme. Variables include modelled farm profit, wheat and sorghum yields, pasture growth, rainfall, drought assistance claims, farmer drought assessments, livestock fertility, jobs, incomes, small business exits, property transfers, insolvencies and migration. It was deposited by Neal Hughes (version 2, July 2025) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download. Coverage is Australia. Caveats: the files are small (about 1.5 MB), the years covered are not stated on the page read, and variable meaning relies on the paper. For simulation it links drought hazard indicators to farm, employment and community economic outcomes to calibrate drought impact and recovery models. Related catalogue records include the Brazilian Integrated Drought Index and the EDO Combined Drought Indicator.
